Keep unrelated settings and stated limits intact; do not treat deleting or restarting a transient object as a lasting fix.

Make fresh observations and allow bounded convergence, using waits shorter than the command tool's deadline; if a wait times out, inspect the fresh state and continue from that evidence. Single node, tainted. Deploy app with toleration. Let's check namespace default exists.

Create deployment.

tool_calls.name: bash
tool_calls.arguments:
{"command": "cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/app.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: app
  namespace: default
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: app
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: app
    spec:
      tolerations:
      - key: dedicated
        operator: Equal
        value: gpu
        effect: NoSchedule
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.31.5
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
EOF
kubectl apply -f /tmp/app.yaml"}

tool_calls.arguments: {"command": "kubectl rollout status deploy/app --timeout=90s; echo \"---\"; kubectl get deploy app -o wide; kubectl get pods -l app=app -o wide"}
